say: If your gap is few dark green leaves, grow them by the kitchen door, in a sunny spot safe from goats and chickens.

panel.heading: Set up a sack garden
items: A sunny spot, safe from goats and chickens
Strong sacks with drainage holes
Topsoil mixed with rotted manure
Plant greens on top and in side slits
Harvest outer leaves regularly

say: Use strong woven sacks or old buckets with holes in the bottom. Fill with good topsoil and well-rotted manure or compost.

say: Plant on top and in side slits: efo tete from seed, ugu from its large seeds, waterleaf from cuttings. Water early morning or evening.

say: Kemi spends about 1,500 naira a week on ugu. Can a garden save money?
She buys 4 sacks at 300 naira each, topsoil and manure for 3,000, and seeds and cuttings for 2,000.
The setup is about 6,200 naira. Once the sacks are producing, she saves about 1,500 naira a week, so the garden pays for itself in about 4 weeks.
She moves the saving to eggs for her toddler. And her leaves are picked minutes before cooking, which keeps more vitamin C.
A few local hens can give young children regular eggs. Keep them in a coop or run, away from the kitchen and from where babies crawl.

panel.heading: Eggs from a few hens, safely

cards.d: Use a coop or run, away from the kitchen and where babies crawl and play.
Wash hands after handling birds or collecting eggs. Droppings spread diarrhoea germs.
Cook eggs until the white and the yolk are firm. Eggs are worth more on the child's plate.

say: Wash hands after handling birds or collecting eggs, because contact with droppings spreads germs that cause diarrhoea.

say: One household can change its own pot. A group of households working with partners can change a community.
The primary health care centre offers growth monitoring, MUAC screening, antenatal care and referral.

say: Partners respond to clear requests. For example, Grace leads a fellowship in Makurdi. She visited the clinic and asked for the officer in charge.

Offer what your group will do
Confirm in writing the same day

say: Cooking and tasting together changes what families eat. Pick one recipe that fixes your gap, such as enriched pap, and ask a health worker to co-lead.
Set up a handwashing point with soap and safe water, and follow the five keys in front of everyone.

card.title: Sharing the cost of a demo

say: Ingredients of about 9,000 naira plus 1,000 for fuel makes 10,000 naira, about 670 naira each for 15 people.
Follow up a week later: who cooked it, and what was hard?

say: Finally, compare before and after using exactly the same measures, like your 3-day average diversity score.

panel.heading: Measure, prove, plan
items: Re-measure with exactly the same tools
Prove it lasts: dated photos, trackers
Write SMART goals for 90 days
Share results in five minutes

say: Show the change lasts, with dated garden photos and several weeks of ticked meal plans and trackers.

say: Then write SMART goals: specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound. For example, Bisi's 6 neighbouring households average 3.9. Her goal is 5.0 by day 90.

say: Present the results honestly. A modest real improvement is worth more than an impressive claim nobody can check.
